opportunities.name: n8n / AI-automation QA & stress-testing service (paid trial per agent)
opportunities.what_is_sold: A fixed-scope, paid-trial review of an existing n8n workflow: failure points, edge cases, error handling, integration and AI behaviour checks, plus a written fix list. Review only - no rebuild.
why_it_may_fit: The buyer states the exact scope in the post: review existing workflows, identify bugs, test edge cases, recommend/fix what is not client-ready.
It is explicitly framed as a PAID TRIAL - the buyer is asking to pay, not to receive free help.
Trust barrier matches the research finding: the #1 objection to automation is 'it broke silently last time'. This offer IS the trust product.

CITED: Upwork 8,228-posting dataset (marathon.limited): median AI fixed price $400-500; 50.7% under $500; 7.9% above $5,000. Discriminator on the expensive side: volume, systems, security constraints, human-approval, documentation, warranty.

INFERRED: A QA/stress-test is a bounded, deliverable scope, which is the shape that survives the 50%-under-$500 filter.
The buyer has already built the agents, so there is no discovery cost on our side and no rebuild risk.
